input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Shorten long single-item hero eyebrows on venture pages so they fit one line at 390 px; cap them in a test
errors: First measurement script reported 0 wrapping eyebrows: a 'w' key for viewport width was overwritten by the element's clientWidth; fixed and re-measured.
Wrote the post and report while the pages suite was running; two build.test.mjs tests failed with the suite's own 'files changed while the suite ran' note and passed on re-run.
integrity_issues: The first draft of the post claimed the dropped audience words (students, plant managers) were still on each page; a grep showed that was false for most pages, so the post and report now state the trade-off instead.

doc_friction.issue: Says the build takes 3 to 20 minutes; this run's build finished in about 5. Fine as stated, but the measurement here did not need the dist at all: venture index.html pages carry inline CSS and render the same from source, which is faster for eyebrow/hero checks.

deviations.why: Did not screenshot the hub, a research page, Stories and a blog post before choosing; took the previous polish report's top-ranked next item, which already rested on that survey.
deviations.did: Measured all 184 venture eyebrows at 390 and 320 px and fixed the 47 that wrapped at 390.

notes: Measured in Chromium over ventures/<slug>/index.html: eyebrows on 2+ lines at 390 px 47 -> 0 of 184; at 320 px 100 -> 93, three-line 7 -> 0; total eyebrow lines 231 -> 184 (390), 291 -> 277 (320). flagship-hero-order.test.mjs: 8/8 pass; fails on main for 47 pages. Local `node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs'`: 1884/1886 pass; the 2 failures (build.test.mjs search-results and cache-name) flagged themselves as caused by files I edited mid-run, and both pass on a re-run against the stable tree.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: measure 184 pages at two widths, rewrite 47 labels, add a test, write post and report

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
